headline: UK Ministry of Defence Signs £8.7bn Submarine Maintenance Deal with Babcock
summary: The UK Ministry of Defence has signed an £8.7bn contract with defence company Babcock to maintain Britain’s submarine fleet.
why: Large government defense contracts secure long-term revenue streams for defense contractors and support national military infrastructure.

impacts.name: Babcock International
impacts.why: A major multi-billion pound government contract directly boosts the company's order book and revenue outlook.
